revenuePanel.noneMatchFilters: No invoices match these filters yet.
revenuePanel.revenueBySiteDesc: All time, same filters as above. A combined invoice (one invoice billing several sites of the same project — see Branch Collection's Generate Invoice) has its total split across the sites it billed, proportional to each site's own share of the invoice — so this column always adds up to the "Total revenue (all time)" figure above, and a site's own Invoices count includes every combined invoice it was part of, not just the ones billed to it alone. A Manual Invoice (no linked Duty Roster site) is grouped by its Active Project instead of a site.
revenuePanel.invoiceChecklistDesc: Every active project whose contract has started by the selected month (this panel's own brand/branch filters above still apply). A project with more than one Duty Roster site normally gets one row per site here — unless a single invoice for that month already covers every one of its sites together (a combined invoice, or a Manual Invoice tied to the project as a whole), in which case it stays one row.

revenuePanel.dataMaintenanceDesc: Invoices saved before the branch filter existed have no branchId, so they're excluded whenever a specific branch is selected here or in the Debtor List (they still show up fine under "All branches"). This looks up each such invoice's site to fill in its branch — safe to run more than once, it only touches invoices still missing branchId.

main.title: Security Guard Service - Cost per Manhour
main.subtitle: Drag the sliders or type in the yellow fields. Overtime is priced at a fixed RM per hour. Guards Required drives every calculation and is editable. Currency: RM.

assumptions.title: Assumption Sources
assumptions.epfNote: EPF employer rate 13% applies for monthly wages up to RM5,000 (12% above) - per KWSP Third Schedule. EPF is charged on basic salary only, not on overtime or premium pay.
assumptions.socsoEisNote: SOCSO (Category 1) and EIS employer rates are simplified flat-rate approximations of PERKESO tiered contribution tables; use the official PERKESO table for payroll-exact figures.
assumptions.otModeFixed: Overtime mode: FIXED RATE. Every overtime hour is paid at the RM per hour entered above, independent of the basic hourly rate.
assumptions.otModeMultiplier: Overtime mode: MULTIPLIER. Every overtime hour is paid at the multiplier times the basic hourly rate, so it moves with basic salary.
assumptions.otModeOnlyBasic: Overtime mode: ONLY BASIC. Overtime, rest day pay and public holiday pay are excluded entirely - cost per guard is based on basic salary (plus statutory contributions) only.

siteRequirement.title: 1. Client Site Requirement
siteRequirement.patternDN: Different posts for day and night shift
siteRequirement.patternWW: Different posts for weekday and weekend (day = night)
siteRequirement.patternFULL: Different posts for weekday/weekend and day/night
siteRequirement.patternCUSTOM: Custom post list - mixed shift hours
siteRequirement.complianceModeDesc: Caps every guard at {{maxHours}}h/week (regular + OT combined) when quoting a client site that must comply with the RBA Code of Conduct, SMETA/ETI, or Malaysia's Employment Act — the strictest of the three, so it satisfies all of them at once. When on, Guards Required - Suggested (Section 3) and every downstream cost/quote figure reflect the headcount actually needed to stay compliant, not just the bare roster-coverage minimum.
siteRequirement.customPostListNote: Each block is a number of posts covering one shift length, on weekdays, weekends or every day, in the day or night period. Example: 1 post day shift 12 hours on weekdays, plus 2 posts day shift 16 hours on weekdays. Blocks are independent so shift lengths can differ. In this mode Coverage Hours per Day and Hours per Shift no longer drive coverage - Hours per Shift still drives the wage build-up - and Coverage Days per Week still decides which days are worked.
siteRequirement.dayNightNote: A shift counts as day when it starts between 06:00 and 18:00 (derived from Roster Start Hour and Hours per Shift); anything else is night. Weekend means Saturday and Sunday. If Coverage Days per Week is 5 or fewer, weekend posts are never used.
siteRequirement.complianceBannerIntro: RBA/SMETA compliance mode is on: no guard may exceed {{maxHours}}h/week. This site's ~{{weeklyManHours}}h/week of coverage needs at least
siteRequirement.complianceBannerCapSuffix: to keep every guard's shifts under that cap
siteRequirement.complianceBannerMoreThan: — {{extra}} more than the {{base}} the roster math alone would suggest.
siteRequirement.complianceBannerAlreadyCovered: (already covered by the roster math alone).

guardGrades.title: 1b. Guard Grades - Secondary Requirement
guardGrades.compulsoryHeading: Compulsory grades - billed to the client at their own rate
guardGrades.specialHeading: Special grades - billed together with the remaining security guards
guardGrades.remainingSecurityGuards: Remaining security guards (on section 4 basic salary)
guardGrades.warnAllowanceExceedsHeadcount: With-allowance headcount exceeds total headcount for: {{names}}. Capped at the grade headcount.
guardGrades.warnGradedExceedsRequired: Graded headcount {{graded}} exceeds Guards Required {{required}}, so there are no remaining security guards and total headcount has risen to {{total}}.
guardGrades.okHeadcountSummary: {{graded}} graded plus {{remaining}} remaining security guards = {{total}} total headcount.
guardGrades.warnNoCompulsoryGrades: No compulsory grades entered, so section 6b has nothing to bill separately.
guardGrades.note: Compulsory grades are quoted to the client separately in section 6b, with their own markup. Special grades are pooled with the remaining security guards and quoted at the main rate in section 6. Remaining headcount is Guards Required less all graded headcount, and those guards are costed on the Basic Salary in section 4. Overtime, rest-day and public-holiday terms and all statutory rates are shared by every grade. Coverage manhours and misc costs are split between the two billing streams in proportion to headcount.

shiftRoster.suggestedNoteCompliance: The suggested figure assumes each guard covers one shift on each working day (rest days rotate across the roster), raised as needed to keep every guard under the RBA/SMETA compliance cap set in Section 1. The editable field is what every downstream calculation uses - it follows the suggestion automatically until you change it. Press Sync to suggested to reconnect it.

rosterPreview.cannotBuild: Cannot build a roster - check guard posts, coverage hours, hours per shift and Guards Required.
rosterPreview.warnShortBySlots: Short by {{unfilled}} shift slots over {{days}} days. {{slotsPerDay}} slots must be filled each covered day but only {{guards}} guards are available, and no guard is double-booked on the same day. Increase Guards Required to at least {{slotsPerDay}}.

Change Guards Required and the roster re-draws.

miscCost.title: 4c. Misc / Equipment Cost
miscCost.compulsoryHeading: Compulsory items - issued per guard over the contract period
miscCost.optionalHeading: Optional items - one-off lump sum or monthly rental over the contract period
miscCost.note: Every line is priced as quantity x price per unit. Compulsory items use quantity per guard x price per unit x Guards Required, paid once and spread over the contract period. A lump sum item is units x price per unit paid once for the whole term, shown per month as the term average. A monthly rental item is units x price per unit charged every month of the term. All misc costs are added to the site cost, so they flow into the cost per manhour, the quoted rate and the contract summary.

managementFee.title: 4d. Management Fee
managementFee.totalFeeRate: Total fee rate (% of revenue billed)
managementFee.warnFeeRateTooHigh: Total fee rate is 100% or more of revenue, which would wipe out all gross profit. Reduce the fee rate.
managementFee.note: Each item is charged as a percentage of the revenue billed to the client. The fee is NOT part of the cost per manhour or the quoted rate - the client is not charged for it. It is deducted from gross profit after revenue is billed, producing the final gross profit and final margin shown in sections 6 and 7 and in the summary panel.

saveQuotationPanel.syncDenied: Signed in — no access to saved quotations
saveQuotationPanel.note: Save stores every figure on this page - all inputs, guard posts, grades, misc items and fees - together with the Client Name, the date and time saved, who saved it and which branch it belongs to. This syncs automatically with your CRM team, the same way Duty Roster does - once Sync status reads Live, every save, load and delete is shared instantly with everyone who can see this branch. Admin and HQ see every saved quotation from every branch; a Branch Manager sees and saves only their own branch's. If sync is briefly unavailable, saves stay local to this browser - use Export Backup to keep a portable copy, and Import Backup to bring a backup file back in.
